fixed_runtime.unknown_reason: Select and freeze authorized runtime settings before trials; construction session is not a trial.

scoring.functional: All external fixed regression and feature cases pass; protected public tests, dependency and harness settings unchanged.
scoring.architecture: Static imports pass AND human reviewer confirms routes only validate/serialize/delegate, no unrelated source changes and no test weakening.
scoring.combined: functional AND architecture; no exclusions removed from attempt denominator
scoring.route_delegation: Reject extraction label parsing, field normalization or score calculation in API; allow request argument forwarding and serialization.
scoring.unrelated_changes: Reject source edits outside confidence plumbing and supporting regression tests; report each file and objective reason.
scoring.test_weakening: Reject deletion, changed assertions or settings affecting frozen public tests; additional tests allowed.
scoring.review: Record reviewer identity, findings with lines, and blinding. Local construction review is unblinded. Trial review pending.

privacy: Evaluator privacy not established. Use filesystem isolation before claiming hidden evaluation; otherwise label tests agent-visible.
ledger: Validate records using experiments/scripts/summarize.py; unavailable values are null with missing_reasons.
